tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun bzang thugs gter las bla sgrub byin rlabs sgron me'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs/ /kun khyab 'gyur med chos sku kun tu bzang*/ /ye shes rang snang longs sku rigs lnga'i gtso/ /sprul pa'i skur ston pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal gnub ban nam mkha'i snying*/ /byang chub gling pa dpal gyi rgyal mtshan dang*/ /zab gter mdzod 'dzin mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /blo gros mtha' yas mdo sngags bstan 'dzin zhabs/ /'gyur med rgya mtsho chos kyi blo gros dang*/ /'gyur med theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /mkhyen brtse'i rang mdangs chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs/ /dngos brgyud dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro dam can la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /yang dag lta bas gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs/ /'khrul med sgom pas 'od gsal khor yug 'byams/ /zhen med spyod pa'i brtul zhugs mthar phyin te/ /kun bzang rgyal srid thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /ces pa'ang phun tshogs rnam rgyal pas mkhyen brtse'i dbang khang du 'di'i smin grol 'bogs skabs gsol ba btab pa'o//
